scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "server,studio,site" -c "blue,magenta,green" "npm run dev -w @cms/server" "npm run dev -w @cms/studio" "npm run dev -w @cms/site-template"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cms/shared && npm run build -w @cms/server && npm run build -w @cms/studio && npm run build -w @cms/site-template
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cms/shared && npm run typecheck -w @cms/server && npm run typecheck -w @cms/studio && npm run typecheck -w @cms/site-template
